The attached idle sheet establishes the EXACT heavy black iron and brass armored fighter: enclosed round helmet with amber grille, chest gauge, shoulder lantern, large gauntlets and greaves, back boiler. Preserve helmet shape, limb lengths, plating design, colors and body size across frames. No skin or face exposed.
ARMED: retain exactly one tower shield on the far arm and one brass pressure rod in the near gauntlet. No extra equipment. For a free-hand action, keep the rod gripped along the palm while moving that hand.
Exactly 12 frames in FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, chronological left-to-right then down. All rows are successive frames of the SAME action: throw_forward. One forward THROW gesture with no other person drawn. Start hands forward as if gripping, draw hands inward with torso loading left, then extend arms forcefully RIGHT and release open palm, then settle into ready stance. Clear smooth anticipation, release and recovery.
Real intermediate joint positions, small continuous changes between neighboring frames across row breaks. Heavy armor feels weighty. RIGHT-facing side/three-quarter camera throughout. Fixed anatomical root and identical proportions, no per-frame resizing. Character is approximately65percent of cell height, all limbs/equipment fully inside each cell with generous transparent gutters. Detailed crisp pixel art, no soft painterly shading, no floor, shadow, grid, labels, background, opponent or particles. Actual transparent RGBA background.

motion: One horizontal CAST. Start ready, raise casting hand or pistol-wand progressively to aim RIGHT, hold aim briefly, show small recoil in arm only, lower hand back to ready. No projectile, muzzle flash, glowing effect or other objects; those are separate layers.
